CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.workflow_identity(value text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$ SELECT lower(regexp_replace(btrim(coalesce(value,'')),'\s+',' ','g')) $function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.operations_natural_sort_v1(p_value text)
 RETURNS text[]
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT ARRAY(SELECT CASE WHEN token[1] ~ '^[0-9]+$'
   THEN '0'||lpad(length(ltrim(token[1],'0'))::text,10,'0')||ltrim(token[1],'0')
   ELSE '1'||token[1] END
 FROM regexp_matches(lower(p_value),'[0-9]+|[^0-9]+','g') WITH ORDINALITY AS chunks(token,n)
 ORDER BY n)
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tracker_page_cells_v1(p_cells jsonb, p_count bigint, p_fields bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF p_count<>p_fields THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='21000',MESSAGE='Ambiguous tracker field binding; repair metadata before paging.'; END IF;
 RETURN coalesce(p_cells,'{}'::jsonb);
END; $function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tracker_page_text_v1(p_value jsonb, p_fallback text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v jsonb:=p_value; parsed jsonb; n bigint;
BEGIN
 IF v IS NULL OR v='null'::jsonb THEN RETURN p_fallback; END IF;
 IF jsonb_typeof(v)='string' THEN
   BEGIN parsed:=(v#>>'{}')::jsonb; EXCEPTION WHEN invalid_text_representation THEN parsed:=NULL; END;
   IF jsonb_typeof(parsed)='object' AND jsonb_typeof(parsed->'__alzhen_transmittal_pod_values_v1')='object' THEN
     SELECT count(DISTINCT value),min(value::text)::jsonb INTO n,v
       FROM jsonb_each(parsed->'__alzhen_transmittal_pod_values_v1')
       WHERE value NOT IN ('null'::jsonb,'""'::jsonb);
     IF n>1 OR v IS NULL THEN RETURN p_fallback; END IF;
   END IF;
 END IF;
 IF v='{"__alzhen_tracker_empty_override_v1__":true}'::jsonb
   OR (jsonb_typeof(v)='object' AND v->'__alzhen_tracker_empty_override_v1__'='true'::jsonb) THEN RETURN ''; END IF;
 IF jsonb_typeof(v)='string' THEN RETURN v#>>'{}'; END IF;
 RETURN '';
END; $function$

views.sql:
WITH sources AS (
         SELECT 'LOADING'::text AS source_type,
            loading_reports.id AS source_record_id,
            loading_reports.trip_id,
            NULL::uuid AS trip_stop_id,
            loading_reports.event_type,
            NULL::timestamp with time zone AS event_date,
            NULL::text AS reason,
            NULL::numeric AS number_of_boxes,
            NULL::text AS comments,
            NULL::uuid AS reporter_id
           FROM loading_reports
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'UNLOADING'::text,
            unloading_reports.id,
            unloading_reports.trip_id,
            unloading_reports.trip_stop_id,
            unloading_reports.event_type,
            NULL::timestamp with time zone,
            NULL::text,
            NULL::numeric,
            NULL::text,
            NULL::uuid
           FROM unloading_reports
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'BACKLOAD'::text,
            backloads.id,
            backloads.trip_id,
            backloads.trip_stop_id,
            backloads.event_type,
            NULL::timestamp with time zone,
            backloads.reason,
            backloads.number_of_boxes,
            backloads.comments,
            COALESCE(backloads.created_by, backloads.submitted_by) AS "coalesce"
           FROM backloads
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'OFFLOAD'::text,
            offloads.id,
            offloads.trip_id,
            offloads.trip_stop_id,
            offloads.event_type,
            COALESCE(offloads.reported_at, (offloads.report_date::timestamp without time zone AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Manila'::text), offloads.created_at) AS "coalesce",
            offloads.reason,
            offloads.number_of_boxes,
            offloads.comments,
            COALESCE(offloads.created_by, offloads.submitted_by) AS "coalesce"
           FROM offloads
        ), unique_primary AS (
         SELECT a.id,
            a.trip_id,
            a.truck_id,
            a.driver_id,
            a.trucking_company_id,
            a.assignment_type,
            a.assigned_at,
            a.unassigned_at,
            a.remarks,
            a.created_at,
            a.updated_at,
            a.collaboration_version
           FROM trip_truck_assignments a
          WHERE a.assignment_type = 'PRIMARY'::text AND a.unassigned_at IS NULL AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM trip_truck_assignments b
                  WHERE b.trip_id = a.trip_id AND b.assignment_type = 'PRIMARY'::text AND b.unassigned_at IS NULL AND b.id <> a.id))
        ), projected AS (
         SELECT t.trip_number,
            r.source_type,
            r.source_record_id,
            r.trip_id,
            r.trip_stop_id,
            r.event_type AS report_type,
                CASE
                    WHEN r.source_type = 'UNLOADING'::text THEN s.finish_unloading_time
                    ELSE r.event_date
                END AS date,
            COALESCE(
                CASE
                    WHEN r.trip_stop_id IS NULL THEN t.dispatch_number
                    ELSE s.dispatch_number
                END, t.trip_number::text) AS trip,
            truck.plate_number,
            NULLIF(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM concat_ws(' '::text, d.first_name, d.last_name)), ''::text), TRIM(BOTH FROM concat_ws(' '::text, dp.first_name, dp.last_name))), ''::text) AS driver_name,
            route.value ||
                CASE
                    WHEN s.stop_sequence IS NOT NULL THEN ' · Stop '::text || s.stop_sequence::text
                    ELSE ''::text
                END AS route,
                CASE
                    WHEN r.source_type = 'OFFLOAD'::text THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM s.dr_number), ''::text), oi.dr_number)
                    ELSE li.dr_number
                END AS dr_number,
                CASE
                    WHEN r.source_type = 'OFFLOAD'::text THEN oi.quantity
                    WHEN r.source_type = 'BACKLOAD'::text THEN r.number_of_boxes
                    ELSE li.quantity
                END AS quantity,
                CASE
                    WHEN r.source_type = 'OFFLOAD'::text THEN oi.total_cbm
                    WHEN r.source_type = 'BACKLOAD'::text THEN NULL::numeric
                    ELSE li.cbm
                END AS total_cbm,
                CASE
                    WHEN r.source_type = 'LOADING'::text THEN t.remarks
                    WHEN r.source_type = 'UNLOADING'::text THEN s.remarks
                    WHEN r.source_type = 'BACKLOAD'::text THEN COALESCE(r.comments, r.reason)
                    ELSE r.comments
                END AS remarks,
            NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM concat_ws(' '::text, rp.first_name, rp.last_name)), ''::text) AS reported_by,
            r.reason,
            r.comments,
            r.number_of_boxes
           FROM sources r
             JOIN trips t ON t.id = r.trip_id
             LEFT JOIN trip_stops s ON s.id = r.trip_stop_id AND s.trip_id = r.trip_id
             LEFT JOIN unique_primary a ON a.trip_id = t.id
             LEFT JOIN trucks truck ON truck.id = a.truck_id
             LEFT JOIN drivers d ON d.id = a.driver_id
             LEFT JOIN profiles dp ON dp.id = d.profile_id
             LEFT JOIN profiles rp ON rp.id = r.reporter_id
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT sum(l.quantity) AS quantity,
                    sum(l.cbm) AS cbm,
                    string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM l.dr_number), ''::text), ', '::text ORDER BY (NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM l.dr_number), ''::text))) AS dr_number
                   FROM trip_line_items l
                  WHERE l.trip_id = r.trip_id AND (r.trip_stop_id IS NULL OR s.id IS NOT NULL AND l.trip_stop_id = s.id)) li ON true
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT sum(i.quantity) AS quantity,
                    sum(i.total_cbm) AS total_cbm,
                    string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM i.dr_number), ''::text), ', '::text ORDER BY (NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM i.dr_number), ''::text))) AS dr_number
                   FROM offload_items i
                  WHERE r.source_type = 'OFFLOAD'::text AND i.offload_id = r.source_record_id) oi ON true
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM w.name), ''::text), 'Warehouse not set'::text) || COALESCE(' → '::text || string_agg(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM cs.name), ''::text), NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM c.name), ''::text), 'Stop '::text || COALESCE(rs.stop_sequence::text, '(sequence unavailable)'::text)), ' → '::text ORDER BY rs.stop_sequence, rs.id), ''::text) AS value
                   FROM trip_stops rs
                     LEFT JOIN customer_stores cs ON cs.id = rs.store_id
                     LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.id = rs.customer_id
                     RIGHT JOIN ( SELECT wh.name
                           FROM ( VALUES (1)) seed(n)
                             LEFT JOIN warehouses wh ON wh.id = t.warehouse_id) w ON rs.trip_id = t.id
                  GROUP BY w.name) route ON true
          WHERE NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM operations_report_conversions cv
                  WHERE cv.source_type = r.source_type AND cv.source_id = r.source_record_id))
        )
 SELECT trip_number,
    source_type,
    source_record_id,
    trip_id,
    trip_stop_id,
    report_type,
    date,
    trip,
    plate_number,
    driver_name,
    route,
    dr_number,
    quantity,
    total_cbm,
    remarks,
    reported_by,
    reason,
    comments,
    number_of_boxes,
    operations_natural_sort_v1(trip) AS trip_sort,
    operations_natural_sort_v1(plate_number) AS plate_number_sort,
    operations_natural_sort_v1(driver_name) AS driver_name_sort,
    operations_natural_sort_v1(route) AS route_sort,
    operations_natural_sort_v1(dr_number) AS dr_number_sort,
    operations_natural_sort_v1(report_type) AS report_type_sort,
    operations_natural_sort_v1(remarks) AS remarks_sort,
    operations_natural_sort_v1(reported_by) AS reported_by_sort,
    concat_ws(' '::text, trip_number::text, trip, plate_number, driver_name, route, dr_number, quantity::text, total_cbm::text, report_type, remarks, reported_by, reason, comments, number_of_boxes::text) AS search_text
   FROM projected p;

         SELECT s_1.id AS stop_id,

                  WHERE (ft.settings ->> 'system_key'::text) = 'alzhen_transmittal_tracker_v1'::text AND ft.archived_at IS NULL AND fr.row_kind = 'SOURCE'::text AND fr.source_entity_type = 'STOP'::text AND fr.archived_at IS NULL AND fr.source_entity_id = s_1.id) AS source_row_id
           FROM trip_stops s_1
        )
 SELECT s.id AS trip_stop_id,
    s.trip_id,
    s.stop_sequence,
    COALESCE(s.dr_number, tracker_page_text_v1(c.value -> 'delivery_receipt_no_override'::text, COALESCE(li.single_dr, ''::text))) AS delivery_receipt_no,
    TRIM(BOTH FROM concat_ws(' '::text, NULLIF(d.first_name, ''::text), NULLIF(d.last_name, ''::text))) AS driver_name,
    tracker_page_text_v1(c.value -> 'transmittal_ref'::text, ''::text) AS transmittal_ref,
    tracker_page_text_v1(c.value -> 'warehouse_code_override'::text, COALESCE(TRIM(BOTH FROM w.code), ''::text)) AS warehouse_code,
    tracker_page_text_v1(c.value -> 'delivered_to_override'::text, COALESCE(NULLIF(st.name, ''::text), cu.name, ''::text)) AS delivered_to,
    tracker_page_text_v1(c.value -> 'plate_number_override'::text, COALESCE(TRIM(BOTH FROM tr.plate_number), ''::text)) AS plate_number,
    tracker_page_text_v1(c.value -> 'sales_order_no_override'::text, COALESCE(li.sales_orders, ''::text)) AS sales_order_no,
    tracker_page_text_v1(c.value -> 'date_created_override'::text, ''::text) AS date_created,
    tracker_page_text_v1(c.value -> 'tracker_status'::text, COALESCE(TRIM(BOTH FROM s.delivery_status), ''::text)) AS status,
    tracker_page_text_v1(c.value -> 'lbc_waybill_no'::text, COALESCE(TRIM(BOTH FROM t.lbc_tracking_number), ''::text)) AS lbc_waybill_no,
    tracker_page_text_v1(c.value -> 'lbc_shipping_date'::text, COALESCE("left"(t.pod_ac_shipping_date::text, 10), ''::text)) AS shipping_date_via_lbc,
    tracker_page_text_v1(c.value -> 'tracker_remarks'::text, ''::text) AS remarks,
    tracker_page_text_v1(c.value -> 'loading_date_override'::text, COALESCE("left"(t.loading_date::text, 10), ''::text)) AS loading_date,
    tracker_page_text_v1(c.value -> 'delivery_date_override'::text, COALESCE("left"(s.finish_unloading_time::text, 10), ''::text)) AS date_delivered,
    a.id AS assignment_id,
    tr.plate_number AS assigned_plate_number
   FROM trip_stops s
     JOIN trips t ON t.id = s.trip_id
     JOIN tracker_rows r ON r.stop_id = s.id
     LEFT JOIN warehouses w ON w.id = t.warehouse_id
     LEFT JOIN customer_stores st ON st.id = s.store_id
     LEFT JOIN customers cu ON cu.id = s.customer_id
     LEFT JOIN active_convoy_assignments a ON a.trip_id = s.trip_id AND (a.stop_scope = 'ALL'::text OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM trip_assignment_stops responsibility
          WHERE responsibility.assignment_id = a.id AND responsibility.trip_stop_id = s.id)))
     LEFT JOIN trucks tr ON tr.id = a.truck_id
     LEFT JOIN drivers d ON d.id = a.driver_id
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM i.sap_so_number), ''::text), ', '::text ORDER BY (NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM i.sap_so_number), ''::text))) AS sales_orders,
                CASE
                    WHEN count(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM i.dr_number), ''::text)) = 1 THEN min(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM i.dr_number), ''::text))
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END AS single_dr
           FROM trip_line_items i
          WHERE i.trip_stop_id = s.id AND i.trip_id = s.trip_id) li ON true
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT tracker_page_cells_v1(jsonb_object_agg(co.settings ->> 'system_key'::text, ce.value) FILTER (WHERE (co.settings ->> 'system_key'::text) IS NOT NULL), count(*) FILTER (WHERE (co.settings ->> 'system_key'::text) IS NOT NULL), count(DISTINCT co.settings ->> 'system_key'::text)) AS value
           FROM flex_cells ce
             JOIN flex_columns co ON co.id = ce.column_id
          WHERE ce.row_id = r.source_row_id AND co.table_id = (( SELECT flex_rows.table_id
                   FROM flex_rows
                  WHERE flex_rows.id = r.source_row_id)) AND co.binding_scope = 'STOP'::text AND NOT co.is_archived) c ON true

views.name: v_trip_filter_flags
views.sql:
SELECT id AS trip_id,
    (upper(btrim(COALESCE(status, ''::text))) <> ALL (ARRAY['CANCELLED'::text, 'CANCELED'::text, 'CLOSED'::text, 'ARCHIVED'::text, 'REJECTED'::text])) AND
        CASE
            WHEN (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
               FROM trip_stops s
              WHERE s.trip_id = t.id)) THEN (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
               FROM trip_stops s
              WHERE s.trip_id = t.id AND s.departure_time IS NULL AND COALESCE(s.delivery_status, ''::text) !~* 'COMPLET|DELIVER|FINISH'::text))
            ELSE upper(btrim(COALESCE(status, ''::text))) <> ALL (ARRAY['COMPLETED'::text, 'CANCELLED'::text, 'CANCELED'::text, 'CLOSED'::text, 'FINISHED'::text, 'ARCHIVED'::text, 'REJECTED'::text])
        END AS ongoing,
    upper(COALESCE(status, ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['IN_PROGRESS'::text, 'IN PROGRESS'::text, 'IN_TRANSIT'::text, 'IN TRANSIT'::text, 'DISPATCHED'::text, 'LOADING'::text, 'UNLOADING'::text, 'ONGOING'::text, 'STARTED'::text, 'DELAYED'::text, 'ON_HOLD'::text]) AS in_progress,
    upper(COALESCE(status, ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['COMPLETED'::text, 'DELIVERED'::text, 'DONE'::text, 'CLOSED'::text]) AS completed,
    (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM offloads r
          WHERE r.trip_id = t.id)) AS offload,
    (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM backloads r
          WHERE r.trip_id = t.id)) AS backload,
    (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM demurrages r
          WHERE r.trip_id = t.id)) AS demurrage
   FROM trips t;

views.name: v_trip_assignment_totals
views.sql:
SELECT a.id AS assignment_id,
    a.trip_id,
    COALESCE(c.assigned_cbm, 0::numeric) AS assigned_cbm,
    tr.capacity_cbm
   FROM trip_truck_assignments a
     LEFT JOIN trucks tr ON tr.id = a.truck_id
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT trip_cargo_allocations.assignment_id,
            sum(trip_cargo_allocations.allocated_cbm) AS assigned_cbm
           FROM trip_cargo_allocations
          GROUP BY trip_cargo_allocations.assignment_id) c ON c.assignment_id = a.id;

views.name: v_trip_cargo_totals
views.sql:
SELECT t.id AS trip_id,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(i.unknown_cbm, 0::bigint) > 0 THEN NULL::numeric
            ELSE COALESCE(i.total_cbm, 0::numeric)
        END AS total_cbm,
    COALESCE(a.assigned_cbm, 0::numeric) AS assigned_cbm,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(i.unknown_cbm, 0::bigint) > 0 THEN NULL::numeric
            ELSE COALESCE(i.total_cbm, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(a.assigned_cbm, 0::numeric)
        END AS remaining_cbm
   FROM trips t
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT trip_line_items.trip_id,
            sum(trip_line_items.cbm) AS total_cbm,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE trip_line_items.cbm IS NULL) AS unknown_cbm
           FROM trip_line_items
          GROUP BY trip_line_items.trip_id) i ON i.trip_id = t.id
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT trip_cargo_allocations.trip_id,
            sum(trip_cargo_allocations.allocated_cbm) AS assigned_cbm
           FROM trip_cargo_allocations
          GROUP BY trip_cargo_allocations.trip_id) a ON a.trip_id = t.id;
